request.initial_prompt: "No, no, Pip!" said Joe, in a comfortable tone, "_I_'m sure of that. Ay, ay, old chap! Bless you, it were only necessary to get it well round in a man's mind, to be certain on it. But it took a bit of time to get it well round, the change come so oncommon plump; didn't it?"
